Closes [#101725](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101725). [#101767](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101767) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#109540](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109540): Fixes a LOGICAL ERROR (Unexpected size of index type) that could occur in RIGHT JOIN and FULL JOIN queries when the `max_bytes_in_join` setting was configured. [#102042](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102042) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#112814](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112814): Fix exception "Cannot fold actions for projection" in join reorder optimization when a LEFT/RIGHT JOIN with `join_use_nulls` is combined with other joins involving more than two tables. [#102516](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102516) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110423](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110423): Fix LOGICAL_ERROR crash "Unexpected number of rows in column subchunk" in native Parquet V3 reader when reading nullable columns with a WHERE filter. [#102628](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102628) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108867](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108867): Fix a server abort during `RESTORE` of backups containing tables with cyclic dependencies. [#103824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103824) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#109336](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109336): Fixed a race between `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN` and a concurrent `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` (or any background merge) in `MergeTree` that could silently replace the renamed column's data with default values. The race window between publishing the new in-memory metadata and registering the rename mutation in `current_mutations_by_version` is now closed by holding `currently_processing_in_background_mutex` across both operations. [#104822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104822) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#106547](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106547): Fixed a server crash that could occur when a query reading from PostgreSQL — via the postgresql table function, the PostgreSQL table engine, or a dictionary with a PostgreSQL source — was cancelled (for example with KILL QUERY) and cancelling the remote PostgreSQL query failed. [#105949](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105949) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#106544](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106544): Continuation of https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/96754 but for delta lake. [#106115](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106115) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#109525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109525): Fix `optimize_skip_unused_shards` did not apply (and force_optimize_skip_unused_shards falsely failing) when a `Distributed` table is queried through a `Merge` table or the `merge` table function, with the predicate applied above it. [#106250](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106250) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#106510](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106510): When deserializing Avro enum data, we don't validate the values, and if those are corrupted, it leads to OOB and abort. [#106476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106476) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#113161](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113161): Fix a `LOGICAL_ERROR` (`Invalid number of rows in Chunk`) in `JoiningTransform` for a `LEFT JOIN` with unique right keys, a mixed `ON` condition, and a small `max_joined_block_size_rows`. [#106928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106928) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110818](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110818): Fix a server crash when moving an empty part to a `plain_rewritable` disk (for example with `ALTER TABLE ... MOVE PARTITION ... TO DISK` for an empty part kept by `remove_empty_parts = 0`). [#107040](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107040) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110656): Fixed wrong query results caused by the query condition cache when on-fly mutations (`apply_mutations_on_fly`) or patch parts filtered rows before `PREWHERE`. A query reading with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 1` could poison the cache so that a later query with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 0` and the same predicate skipped marks it should have read and returned too few rows. The same fix also covers row-level security policies, which are prepended as a filter ahead of `PREWHERE`: a query run under a restrictive row policy could poison the cache for a later query that uses the same predicate without that policy. [#107145](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107145) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108918](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108918): Incremental backups no longer store `S3` credentials in the `<base_backup>` locator of the `.backup` metadata file. Backups created with `use_same_s3_credentials_for_base_backup = 1`, or with explicit base backup credentials matching this backup locator, store a non-secret marker and are restored without extra restore-time settings; for backups created with different explicit base backup credentials or extra base authentication arguments, pass them to `RESTORE` with the `base_backup` setting. Backups created by older versions with embedded credentials remain restorable. [#107357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107357) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110339](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110339): Fixed `SELECT ... FINAL` and `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` returning duplicate rows after `CREATE TABLE ... CLONE AS`, `ATTACH PARTITION ... FROM` or `MOVE PARTITION ... TO TABLE` adopted parts from a plain `MergeTree` into a `ReplacingMergeTree`, `SummingMergeTree` or `AggregatingMergeTree`. The adopted part's merge level is now reset to 0 when the source and destination engines differ, so the destination deduplicates it on the next merge. [#107481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107481) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112098](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112098): Fix a `Logical error: Stream ... variant_discr ... is not found` that could occur when merging or reading a `MergeTree` part produced by a mutation of a table with a `Dynamic` column. [#107562](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107562) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#109788](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109788): Fixed incorrect results from distributed queries selecting `ALIAS` columns that share a common subexpression: columns could be misaligned and values returned under the wrong column. [#107675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107675) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#107821](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107821): Fixed the MySQL interface being unusable with `MySQL Connector/J` 8.2.0 and newer (including 9.x). The `info` field of the `OK` packet is now length-encoded, matching the MySQL server, so the JDBC driver can connect. [#107693](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107693) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#111911](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111911): Fix server crash (SIGSEGV) when reading Protobuf data with `input_format_allow_errors_num > 0` and a valid message precedes a bad (skippable) message in the same block. [#107739](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107739) ([Andrey Tsarevskiy | Андрей Царевский ](https://github.com/atsarevskiy)).
* Backported in [#108396](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108396): Fix performance regression for Map subcolumns with PREWHERE. Closes [#107912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107912). Caused by: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99200. [#107988](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107988) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#110808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110808): A transient error while refreshing data parts of a read-only table no longer permanently stops the background refresh task. [#108034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108034) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110962](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110962): Hide sensitive info in system.query_views_log.view_query. [#108214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108214) ([Valerii Mordovskii](https://github.com/Fidelaggio)).
* Backported in [#111599](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111599): Fix `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` error for queries that use the `_part_starting_offset/_part_offset` virtual columns in WHERE together with lazy materialization. [#108287](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108287) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#109152](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109152): `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` now requires the new `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` privilege. Previously any authenticated user (including `readonly` ones) could run it and repeatedly reset the DDL worker state, blocking `ON CLUSTER` DDL. [#108460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108460) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109820](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109820): Restrict the model path of `catboostEvaluate` to the `user_files` directory, like `file()` and the dictionary sources. Previously the function accepted an arbitrary filesystem path with no containment check, which allowed probing the existence of and triggering reads of files outside `user_files`. Models must now be located inside `user_files`. [#108463](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108463) ([Groene AI](https://

github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108778](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108778): Fixed `ssl_certificate` user identification so a single `*` wildcard matches exactly one name component (RFC 6125 6.4.3). Previously a wildcard in a `CN` or `DNS:` SAN subject (for example `*.corp.example.com`) also matched multi-label names such as `evil.deep.corp.example.com`, letting a holder of a certificate for a deeper subdomain authenticate as the wildcard user. `URI:` SAN matching is unchanged. [#108472](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108472) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109274](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109274): Fixed wrong results when using `SELECT [...] SAMPLE [...]` together with the query condition cache (setting `use_query_condition_cache = 1` which is also the default). [#108488](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108488) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108897](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108897): Fixed a server crash (stack overflow) caused by deeply nested expressions such as `[[[ ... ]]]` or `array(array( ... ))` when `max_parser_depth` is set to a large value. [#108493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108493) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109632](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109632): The MySQL wire protocol commands `COM_FIELD_LIST` (`mysql_list_fields`) and `COM_INIT_DB` (`USE database`) now enforce the same access control as their SQL equivalents (`SHOW COLUMNS`/`DESCRIBE` and `USE`). Previously they could disclose column names of tables the user only had partial column grants on, and switch the current database without the `SHOW DATABASES` privilege. [#108508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108508) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109569): Match `http_forbid_headers` case-insensitively. HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so forbidding `Authorization` now also blocks `authorization`, `AUTHORIZATION` and other case variants. Configured `header_regexp` patterns are now matched case-insensitively without needing an explicit `(?i)` flag. [#108509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108509) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110096](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110096): Fix a `SELECT *` projection returning a column's type default (e.g. `0`) instead of its `DEFAULT` value (e.g. `-1`) when reading a column added with `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT` after the projection was created. Reads from the base table were already correct; only reads answered by the projection were affected, until the projection was rebuilt. [#108569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108569) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#108663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108663): Fixed direct read from multiple partially materialized text indexes. [#108607](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108607) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#108893](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108893): Fixed a startup failure where a `DataLakeCatalog` database created by an older version (25.12 or earlier) with a malformed `auth_header` could not be attached after upgrading to 26.2 or later, preventing the server from starting. The `auth_header` is now validated only on `CREATE`, and on `ATTACH` the catalog is built lazily on first use instead of during startup, so a single misconfigured or unreachable catalog database no longer blocks server startup. [#108674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108674) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108823](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108823): Fixed partition and primary key pruning being silently disabled when a `LowCardinality(FixedString)` (or `LowCardinality(Nullable(FixedString))`) key column is wrapped in a function in the key, for example `PARTITION BY sipHash64(k) % N` with `WHERE k = 'literal'`. Such queries scanned all partitions instead of pruning them. [#108777](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108777) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108905](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108905): Fixed `insert_quorum = 'auto'` not rejecting inserts up front when fewer than a majority of replicas were alive. Such inserts now fail immediately with `TOO_FEW_LIVE_REPLICAS` instead of writing a local part and later timing out with `UNKNOWN_STATUS_OF_INSERT`. [#108800](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108800) ([Gagan Dhakrey](https://github.com/gagandhakrey)).
* Backported in [#109142](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109142): Fix a segmentation fault when merging `uniqExact` aggregate states with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` or `CUBE` and `max_threads > 1`. [#108928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108928) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112983](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112983): Fix a server crash (out-of-bounds access) in `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` with `enable_hash_ring_filtering = 1` when a batch contained a non-processable file and the Keeper request to set the batch as processing failed at the same time. [#108977](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108977) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113094](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113094): Preserve original key order in bucketed Map serialization to fix comparison operations that depend on it. [#109178](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109178) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#109561](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109561): Fixed a server crash on asynchronous insert with deduplication when `optimize_on_insert` makes the inserted block empty (for example, rows summing to zero in `SummingMergeTree`). [#109229](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109229) ([Den Kalantaevskii](https://github.com/Diskein)).
* Backported in [#112623](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112623): Fix data loss of a column with no default expression when a merge runs concurrently with `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN`, or when the column's only values come from a lightweight `UPDATE`. The column could be dropped from the merged part, so all of its values read back as NULL. [#109356](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109356) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111639](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111639): Fix `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` error on `ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN` when another column has a `DEFAULT` or `MATERIALIZED` expression that defines and references an inline alias. [#109374](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109374) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#109626](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109626): Fix a data race (and resulting rare crash) in the parallel merge of `uniqExact` aggregate states with two-level sets, which could occur with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` and `CUBE`. [#109389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109389) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111080](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111080): This patch fixes an infinite rescheduling of the rollup merge. [#109410](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109410) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#109805](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109805): Fix a segfault in `groupArrayLastMerge`. Deserialization of aggregated function state is now validated. So a broken state does not lead to OOB. [#109485](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109485) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#109815](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109815): Fix segfault in `largestTriangleThreeBuckets` aggregate function by rejecting broken aggregate function state at the deserialization level. [#109492](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109492) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#111051](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111051): This patch fixes the group by mutations for tables with materialized and virtual columns. If the table has materialized columns or enabled persistent virtual columns, these columns will be aggregated using `any` aggregate. [#109532](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109532) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#109656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109656): Fix redundant file segment contention introduced in 26.1+. [#109577](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109577) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#109826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109826): Fix `system.tables` silently skipping databases for users with per-database grants when the query reads only the `name`/`database` columns. Introduced in 26.2. [#109723](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109723) ([Samay Sharma](https://github.com/samay-sharma)).
* Backported in [#112334](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112334): Fix credential leaks in `SHOW CREATE`, `system.query_log`, server logs and `EXPLAIN` output. Every `S3` locator form now masks `session_token` and Google ADC secrets, `extra_credentials`/`headers` values at any argument position, duplicated or expression secret keys, invalid positional forms (fail closed), and credentials embedded in S3 URLs; this covers the explicit-url and named-collection `s3`/`s3Cluster` table functions, the S3-backed table engines (`S3`, `GCS`, the data-lake engines, `S3Queue`), the `S3` database engine, `BACKUP ... TO S3` and the `Backup` database engine. In addition, secret arguments of `encrypt`/`decrypt`/HMAC that are built by an expression (including ones inlined from a SQL UDF) are now hidden in projection names, `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` and `EXPLAIN actions`. [#109768](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109768) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#110358](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110358): Make headers in `getClientHTTPHeader` case-insensitive according to [RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-5.1). Fixes [#103957](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/103957) by adding `authorization` to the filtered-out headers. [#109791](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109791) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#110900](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110900): Fix reading Iceberg tables whose default sort order references a column that needs quoting (e.g. `@timestamp`). Such tables were unreadable because the synthesized storage `ORDER BY` was built from the raw column name and failed to parse with `SYNTAX_ERROR`. [#110233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111539](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111539): Fixed wrong results for functions `has`, `mapContainsKey` and `mapContainsValue` with an empty needle when a text index is present. [#110246](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110246) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110473](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110473): Fixed a possible crash (heap-buffer-overflow) when a `quantileTDigest`-family aggregate-function state column was used as a `GROUP BY` key and serialized concurrently by several threads. [#110263](https://gi

thub.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110263) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112072](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112072): Fix `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` ordered mode with persistent processing nodes: bucket locks are now refreshed during streaming, so that the TTL cleanup (`persistent_processing_node_ttl_seconds`) does not remove locks of a live processor. If lock ownership is nevertheless lost, it is detected and reported (a logical error and the `ObjectStorageQueueBucketLockLostOwnership` profile event), and streaming recovers with a fresh file iterator. [#110292](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110292) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#111110](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111110): Fixed a server crash (native stack overflow) when a deeply nested `Array`/`Tuple`/`Map`/`Object` literal is copied or destroyed, for example a query with a very deeply nested literal at a raised `max_parser_depth`. [#110393](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110393) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#111710](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111710): Fixed a read-only object-storage replica (a disk configured with `read_only = true`) not discovering new parts via `refresh_parts_interval`, and `table_disk = true` being rejected on such a disk with "table_disk is not supported for non-ObjectStorage disks". [#110460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110460) ([Julia Kartseva](https://github.com/jkartseva)).
* Backported in [#111094](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111094): Fix a logical error (`Column ... already added for reading`, a server abort in debug/sanitizer builds) when the same text-index predicate is used in both `PREWHERE` and `WHERE` of a query over a `Merge` table on top of a `Distributed` table. [#110710](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110710) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111336](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111336): Fix a LOGICAL_ERROR ("No set is registered for key") in ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN, ALTER TABLE ... DELETE/UPDATE mutations, and lightweight DELETE, on tables that have an ALIAS column whose expression uses an IN operator (including through another ALIAS column). [#111039](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111039) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#111358](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111358): Fixed silent data loss with async inserts and deduplication (`async_insert=1`, `async_insert_deduplicate=1`). When several async-insert entries with distinct `insert_deduplication_token` values were coalesced into one flush that wrote to disjoint partitions, each token was registered in the deduplication log of every partition the flush touched, not only the partition its own rows landed in. A later insert reusing one of those tokens in a partition it never wrote to was then silently deduplicated away. Tokens are now registered only against the partition their rows actually landed in. [#111049](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111049) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111260](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111260): Fixed reading `Arrow`/`ArrowStream` data with empty nested `Array`/`Map` columns produced by Apache Arrow Java < 19.0.0 (bundled with Apache Spark), which were previously rejected with an `INCORRECT_DATA` error about the offsets buffer being too small. [#111101](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111101) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#111314](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111314): Fixed asynchronous Native-format inserts so one buffered entry that becomes incompatible after `ALTER ... MODIFY COLUMN` no longer causes the whole batch to fail. [#111108](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111108) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#111633](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111633): Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE` of a dictionary with an object of another kind: it failed with `CANNOT_DETACH_DICTIONARY_AS_TABLE` after the replace was already committed, leaving an orphan `_tmp_replace_*` table. [#111142](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111142) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#111811](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111811): Fix a memory leak of the peer certificate on every TLS handshake with certificate verification enabled: `SecureSocketImpl::verifyPeerCertificateImpl` did not free the certificate returned by `SSL_get1_peer_certificate`. [#111425](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111425) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#112275](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112275): Fix checking paths against `user_files`. [#111442](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111442) ([Alexander Tokmakov](https://github.com/tavplubix)).
* Backported in [#111584](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111584): Fix typo in complex schema evolution. [#111489](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111489) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#111854](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111854): Fix mutations with a query parameter as the partition (`ALTER TABLE ... UPDATE/DELETE ... IN PARTITION {param:Type}`): the substituted partition value was serialized into the mutation entry in a form that could not be parsed back, which broke loading of the table (for replicated tables, on every replica). Mutation commands are now also verified to be parseable back before they are written to ZooKeeper or disk, so that a similar mismatch would fail the `ALTER` query instead of breaking the table. [#111518](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111518) ([Michael Kolupaev](https://github.com/al13n321)).
* Backported in [#112282](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112282): Fix a segfault due to out-of-bounds memory access when deserializing a malformed aggregate function state containing a `String` value. Such states are now validated and rejected instead of leading to segfaults. [#111606](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111606) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#112618](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112618): Fix overflow while parsing in system.zookeeper_info. [#111629](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111629) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#112173](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112173): Fixes `AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN_NAME` (`Block structure mismatch in (columns with identical name must have identical structure)`) for a query that repeats a `JOIN ON` condition in `WHERE` with `join_use_nulls = 1`. Such a query now returns its result instead of failing. [#112007](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112007) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112537](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112537): Fixed Paimon table reads that could fail while the mutable `snapshot/LATEST` hint was being replaced concurrently. Invalid or stale hints now safely fall back to snapshot listing. [#112010](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112010) ([JIaQi Tang](https://github.com/JiaQiTang98)).
* Backported in [#113000](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113000): Fixes a segfault and silent data corruption when an `INSERT` into the `File` engine or the `file` table function appends to a non-empty file in a format that does not support appending, such as `Avro`. Writing through a file descriptor or a partitioned path bypassed the existing check, so the format prefix was suppressed and a second header was written after the existing bytes, leaving the file unreadable. Such an `INSERT` is now rejected with `CANNOT_APPEND_TO_FILE`, as it already is for a plain path. [#112839](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112839) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113015](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113015): Fix `ReadBufferFromEncryptedFile: Wrong file position` logical error when reading a `Compact` part from an `encrypted` disk with direct I/O, which made merges get stuck in `system.replication_queue`. [#112943](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112943) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113254](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113254): Fixed an out-of-bounds write when reading a `Parquet` `DECIMAL` column whose physical type is wider than the type its declared precision maps to, for example `DECIMAL(9, 2)` stored as physical `INT64`. Such files are valid `Parquet` and other writers produce them, but the reader sized the destination column from the declared precision while the decoder wrote the physical width, corrupting memory. Reading such a file now also raises `DECIMAL_OVERFLOW` when a value does not fit the declared precision, instead of returning corrupted data, and reads losslessly with a type hint at least as wide as the physical type. [#113046](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113046) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.17.56-lts (c57540de480) FIXME as compared to v26.3.17.4-lts (00f5ad7bc29)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#109131](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109131): Fixed a performance regression (introduced in [#71781](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/71781)) where reading many small files from object storage via the `s3()` and other table functions stopped prefetching and fell back to synchronous reads, significantly slowing single-threaded / low-concurrency reads of lots of tiny files. [#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108872) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#109556](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109556): Issue the initial small-object prefetch also when object storage reads go through the filesystem cache (`filesystem_cache_name`). Previously ([#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108872)) the prefetch was restored only for non-cached reads, so reads of many small files (e.g. `S3Queue` ingestion) with the filesystem cache enabled remained synchronous and latency-bound. [#109478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109478) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#108850](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108850): Fix `DataLakeCatalog` databases with `catalog_type = 'onelake'` reading table data by using the OneLake Blob endpoint (`.blob.fabric.microsoft.com`) by default. Set `onelake_use_blob_endpoint = false` to keep the previous DFS endpoint (`.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com`) behavior. [#106843](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106843) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#110487](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110487): Fixed reading of the `auth_response` length in the MySQL handshake, where a length byte `>= 128` was interpreted as a multi-gigabyte value because it was read as a signed `char`. [#107384](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107384) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#110385](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110385): MergeTree can now read a compressed stream whose blocks use different codecs. This is the read-side prerequisite for adaptive codec selection (https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/105404). [#108592](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108592) ([Raufs Dunamalijevs](https://github.com/rienath)).
* Backported in [#109268](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109268): Restore `show_data_lake_catalogs_in_system_tables` as the setting that controls only `DataLakeCatalog` visibility in `system.tables`, `system.columns`, and `system.completions`. Added `show_remote_databases_in_system_tables`, enabled by default, to let users hide `MySQL` and `PostgreSQL` databases from those system tables separately. [#109082](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109082) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110414): I always find it difficult to add multiple metrics to the dashboard during debugging sessions. This patch adds a simpler way to add them directly from the source code or documentation. [#109449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109449) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#106436](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106436): Validate column structure before applying patches. [#99531](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99531) ([Seva Potapov](https://github.com/seva-potapov)).
* Backported in [#109542](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109542): Fix credential leak in query_log for paimonCluster, paimonS3Cluster, paimonAzureCluster, and deltaLakeS3 table functions. ### Documentation entry for user-facing changes. [#100529](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100529) ([JIaQi Tang](https://github.com/JiaQiTang98)).
* Backported in [#110423](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110423): Fix LOGICAL_ERROR crash "Unexpected number of rows in column subchunk" in native Parquet V3 reader when reading nullable columns with a WHERE filter. [#102628](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102628) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108867](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108867): Fix a server abort during `RESTORE` of backups containing tables with cyclic dependencies. [#103824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103824) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#109336](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109336): Fixed a race between `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN` and a concurrent `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` (or any background merge) in `MergeTree` that could silently replace the renamed column's data with default values. The race window between publishing the new in-memory metadata and registering the rename mutation in `current_mutations_by_version` is now closed by holding `currently_processing_in_background_mutex` across both operations. [#104822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104822) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#106547](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106547): Fixed a server crash that could occur when a query reading from PostgreSQL — via the postgresql table function, the PostgreSQL table engine, or a dictionary with a PostgreSQL source — was cancelled (for example with KILL QUERY) and cancelling the remote PostgreSQL query failed. [#105949](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105949) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#109525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109525): Fix `optimize_skip_unused_shards` did not apply (and force_optimize_skip_unused_shards falsely failing) when a `Distributed` table is queried through a `Merge` table or the `merge` table function, with the predicate applied above it. [#106250](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106250) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#106510](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106510): When deserializing Avro enum data, we don't validate the values, and if those are corrupted, it leads to OOB and abort. [#106476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106476) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#110818](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110818): Fix a server crash when moving an empty part to a `plain_rewritable` disk (for example with `ALTER TABLE ... MOVE PARTITION ... TO DISK` for an empty part kept by `remove_empty_parts = 0`). [#107040](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107040) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110656): Fixed wrong query results caused by the query condition cache when on-fly mutations (`apply_mutations_on_fly`) or patch parts filtered rows before `PREWHERE`. A query reading with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 1` could poison the cache so that a later query with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 0` and the same predicate skipped marks it should have read and returned too few rows. The same fix also covers row-level security policies, which are prepended as a filter ahead of `PREWHERE`: a query run under a restrictive row policy could poison the cache for a later query that uses the same predicate without that policy. [#107145](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107145) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108918](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108918): Incremental backups no longer store `S3` credentials in the `<base_backup>` locator of the `.backup` metadata file. Backups created with `use_same_s3_credentials_for_base_backup = 1`, or with explicit base backup credentials matching this backup locator, store a non-secret marker and are restored without extra restore-time settings; for backups created with different explicit base backup credentials or extra base authentication arguments, pass them to `RESTORE` with the `base_backup` setting. Backups created by older versions with embedded credentials remain restorable. [#107357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107357) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110339](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110339): Fixed `SELECT ... FINAL` and `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` returning duplicate rows after `CREATE TABLE ... CLONE AS`, `ATTACH PARTITION ... FROM` or `MOVE PARTITION ... TO TABLE` adopted parts from a plain `MergeTree` into a `ReplacingMergeTree`, `SummingMergeTree` or `AggregatingMergeTree`. The adopted part's merge level is now reset to 0 when the source and destination engines differ, so the destination deduplicates it on the next merge. [#107481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107481) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109788](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109788): Fixed incorrect results from distributed queries selecting `ALIAS` columns that share a common subexpression: columns could be misaligned and values returned under the wrong column. [#107675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107675) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#107821](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107821): Fixed the MySQL interface being unusable with `MySQL Connector/J` 8.2.0 and newer (including 9.x). The `info` field of the `OK` packet is now length-encoded, matching the MySQL server, so the JDBC driver can connect. [#107693](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107693) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#108396](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108396): Fix performance regression for Map subcolumns with PREWHERE. Closes [#107912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107912). Caused by: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99200. [#107988](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107988) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#110808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110808): A transient error while refreshing data parts of a read-only table no longer permanently stops the background refresh task. [#108034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108034) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110962](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110962): Hide sensitive info in system.query_views_log.view_query. [#108214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108214) ([Valerii Mordovskii](https://github.com/Fidelaggio)).
* Backported in [#109152](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109152): `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` now requires the new `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` privilege. Previously any authenticated user (including `readonly` ones) could run it and repeatedly reset the DDL worker state, blocking `ON CLUSTER` DDL. [#108460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108460) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109820](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109820): Restrict the model path of `catboostEvaluate` to the `user_files` directory, like `file()` and the dictionary sources. Previously the function accepted an arbitrary filesystem path with no containment check, which allowed probing the existence of and triggering reads of files outside `user_files`. Models must now be located inside `user_files`. [#108463](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108463) ([Groene AI](https://github.

com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109274](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109274): Fixed wrong results when using `SELECT [...] SAMPLE [...]` together with the query condition cache (setting `use_query_condition_cache = 1` which is also the default). [#108488](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108488) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108897](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108897): Fixed a server crash (stack overflow) caused by deeply nested expressions such as `[[[ ... ]]]` or `array(array( ... ))` when `max_parser_depth` is set to a large value. [#108493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108493) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109632](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109632): The MySQL wire protocol commands `COM_FIELD_LIST` (`mysql_list_fields`) and `COM_INIT_DB` (`USE database`) now enforce the same access control as their SQL equivalents (`SHOW COLUMNS`/`DESCRIBE` and `USE`). Previously they could disclose column names of tables the user only had partial column grants on, and switch the current database without the `SHOW DATABASES` privilege. [#108508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108508) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109569): Match `http_forbid_headers` case-insensitively. HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so forbidding `Authorization` now also blocks `authorization`, `AUTHORIZATION` and other case variants. Configured `header_regexp` patterns are now matched case-insensitively without needing an explicit `(?i)` flag. [#108509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108509) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110096](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110096): Fix a `SELECT *` projection returning a column's type default (e.g. `0`) instead of its `DEFAULT` value (e.g. `-1`) when reading a column added with `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT` after the projection was created. Reads from the base table were already correct; only reads answered by the projection were affected, until the projection was rebuilt. [#108569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108569) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#108663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108663): Fixed direct read from multiple partially materialized text indexes. [#108607](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108607) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#108893](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108893): Fixed a startup failure where a `DataLakeCatalog` database created by an older version (25.12 or earlier) with a malformed `auth_header` could not be attached after upgrading to 26.2 or later, preventing the server from starting. The `auth_header` is now validated only on `CREATE`, and on `ATTACH` the catalog is built lazily on first use instead of during startup, so a single misconfigured or unreachable catalog database no longer blocks server startup. [#108674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108674) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108823](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108823): Fixed partition and primary key pruning being silently disabled when a `LowCardinality(FixedString)` (or `LowCardinality(Nullable(FixedString))`) key column is wrapped in a function in the key, for example `PARTITION BY sipHash64(k) % N` with `WHERE k = 'literal'`. Such queries scanned all partitions instead of pruning them. [#108777](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108777) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

### ClickHouse release v26.3.2.3-lts (a1a0cf365ce) FIXME as compared to v26.3.1.896-lts (c152d9127cd)

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#100900](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100900): Added bucketed serialization for Map columns in MergeTree (`map_serialization_version = 'with_buckets'`). Keys are split into hash-based buckets so that reading a single key (`m['key']`) only reads one bucket instead of the entire column, providing 2-49x speedup for single-key lookups depending on map size. The number of buckets and the bucketing strategy can be controlled by new MergeTree settings: `map_serialization_version`, `max_buckets_in_map`, `map_buckets_strategy`, `map_buckets_coefficient`, and `map_buckets_min_avg_size`. The setting `map_serialization_version_for_zero_level_parts` allows keeping basic serialization for inserts to avoid write overhead while merged parts use buckets. Skip indexes on `mapKeys/mapValues` are supported with bucketed serialization. The `optimize_functions_to_subcolumns` pass rewrites `m['key']` to a per-key subcolumn read when buckets are available. [#99200](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99200) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#100866](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100866): Fix `If`, `Distinct`, `DistinctIf`, `IfState ` aggregate function combinators with `Tuple` return type and one or more `Nullable` argument not being able to read older serialized states after introduction of `Nullable(Tuple)`. Closes [#98917](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/98917). [#100826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100826) ([Nihal Z. Miaji](https://github.com/nihalzp)).

* Backported in [#118078](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118078): Fixed a stack overflow when reading hadoop-snappy data containing many blocks that decode to nothing. * Backported in [#118062](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118062): `ENGINE = EmbeddedRocksDB(ttl, rocksdb_dir, read_only)` with an explicit `rocksdb_dir` now requires the `FILE` source grant that `file` requires for the same directory: `READ ON FILE` to create such a table, plus `WRITE ON FILE` when `read_only = 0`. Previously it required no source grant, so a user holding only `CREATE TABLE` in a database of their own could point a table at another table's directory and read its rows. `ON CLUSTER` and `Replicated`-database DDL are not covered: the replay runs with no user. The argument-less form is unaffected. Backward incompatible for anyone already using an explicit `rocksdb_dir` without them. Closes [#78938](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/78938). [#117979](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117979) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118288](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118288): Fixed a privilege escalation in implicit access-rights computation: holding any single child privilege of the `ALTER TABLE` group (for example `ALTER MODIFY COMMENT`) on a view implicitly conferred the entire `ALTER VIEW` group, so such a user could run `ALTER TABLE <view> MODIFY QUERY` and rewrite the view's query. `ALTER VIEW` is now implied only by the complete `ALTER TABLE` grant. A deployment that relied on a partial `ALTER TABLE` grant to alter views must now grant `ALTER VIEW` (or one of its members) or the full `ALTER TABLE` explicitly. [#118194](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118194) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.33.24-lts (211b7286fd9) FIXME as compared to v26.3.32.14-lts (b7f89885710)

#### Backward Incompatible Change
* Backported in [#118546](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118546): Reading a `File` source with `rename_files_after_processing` set now requires the `WRITE ON FILE` grant on top of `READ ON FILE`, on the initiator for `fileCluster`: the setting renames the files a `SELECT` has read, which is a write to the source, and it used to happen for anyone who could read them. A query relying on it now needs `GRANT WRITE ON FILE`. A per-query renaming rule is also no longer cached by a `Filesystem` database, where it could make an unrelated later query rename files, or be dropped silently. [#117895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117895) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#118602](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118602): Fix `Block structure mismatch in stream` error caused by unnecessary columns returned from Lazy materialization. Fixes [#95191](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/95191). [#96682](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/96682) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#118753](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118753): Fix out-of-bounds access in lazy materialization optimization that could cause an exception in debug builds. [#101144](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101144) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117912): Fix an out-of-bounds write when reading a `Variant` column from a malformed Native block whose discriminators reference a variant index that does not exist. [#107991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107991) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#118083](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118083): Fixed SQL injection in the PostgreSQL wire protocol emulation. Prepared-statement parameters — the `Parse`/`Bind`/`Execute` extended-query path used by `psycopg2`, JDBC, `node-postgres`, Npgsql and others, and the simple-query `EXECUTE` path — were substituted into the executed SQL by raw string splicing, so a crafted parameter could break out of its value position and inject SQL. Parameters are now bound as data. This also fixes string parameters that previously failed with `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` when a client sent them unquoted. [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108469) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118613](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118613): Fix `ObjectStorageQueue`/`AzureQueue` (and the `azureBlobStorage` table function) silently skipping objects when the object storage returns an empty listing page together with a continuation token. Azure Blob Storage does this (e.g. when a listing crosses an internal partition boundary), and the async list iterator was treating the empty page as the end of the listing and dropping the token. It now follows the continuation token. [#109761](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109761) ([Gal Ben Moshe](https://github.com/GalBenMoshe)).
* Backported in [#116189](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116189): Fix a data race (and rare crash) when a parsing/analysis error is reported while reading a file/object storage table. A parse error raised during lazy `KeyCondition` initialization was shared as a single exception object across reader threads, and two threads could concurrently append `(in file/uri ...)` to its message, racing on the exception message string. [#109911](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109911) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118543](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118543): RabbitMQ Security related bugfix. [#112479](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112479) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#118726](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118726): Fixed `LOGICAL_ERROR` when reading a table with a `set` skip index defined on an expression and the query repeats that expression with a `Nullable` operand, for example `WHERE intDiv(id, (SELECT 1000)) = 3` over `INDEX b_set intDiv(id, 1000) TYPE set(100)`. A scalar subquery is enough to trigger it, since it is typed `Nullable`. [#113244](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113244) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#115558](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115558): Fix `std::out_of_range: map::at: key not found` when a `MergeTree` key expression contains a `mortonEncode` or `hilbertEncode` call that is not itself a key column, for example `ORDER BY mortonEncode(hilbertEncode(x, y), x, y)` or `PARTITION BY mortonEncode(x, y) % 4`. [#114233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118446](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118446): Fixes asynchronous inserts into `JSON` columns ignoring the `max_dynamic_subcolumns_in_json_type_parsing` setting. Previously, an asynchronous insert (`async_insert = 1`) could store more dynamic paths than the setting allows, giving a different column layout than a synchronous insert with the same settings. The cap is now preserved when asynchronous inserts aggregate parsed data. [#115329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115329) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#117662](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117662): Reject a bare carriage return (`\r`), in addition to a line feed (`\n`), in HTTP header names and values that pass through the HTTP header filter. This closes an HTTP header injection (request/response splitting) gap for features that pass user-provided headers, such as the `url` table function and engine, HTTP dictionaries, and data lake catalogs. [#115510](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115510) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#118676](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118676): Fix a use-after-free in the gRPC server when a query with a streaming input finishes while a read of the next message is still in flight. [#115707](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115707) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118565](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118565): Fixed `h3Line` returning uninitialized memory in the tail of the result array when a line between two valid H3 indices cannot be drawn because it crosses pentagon distortion. Such a call now throws `INCORRECT_DATA`. [#116583](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116583) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118651](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118651): The handshake response of the MySQL wire protocol is now bounded, so a client can no longer make the server grow memory during the handshake. The `mysql_require_secure_transport` server setting is now enforced from the actual state of the connection instead of a capability bit advertised by the client. [#117003](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117003) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118808): Hide the credentials that a setting value can carry, such as the password in `format_avro_schema_registry_url` or `url_base`, everywhere a setting value is displayed or logged. `system.query_log`, `system.processes`, `system.settings`, `system.settings_profile_elements`, `system.session_log`, `system.distributed_ddl_queue`, `SHOW CREATE USER` and `SHOW CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` previously showed them in plaintext to any user who could read them. [#117523](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117523) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118529](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118529): Several aggregate function deserializers allocated memory from a size declared in the serialized state before reading the payload, so a state of a few bytes could request gigabytes. They now read only what the buffer already holds. [#117536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117536) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118033): Fixes a potential out-of-bounds write of function `formatDateTimeInJodaSyntax` when called with a time zone name longer than 32 characters. [#117925](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117925) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#118324](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118324): `CREATE USER OR REPLACE` and the `OR REPLACE` form of `CREATE ROLE`, `CREATE QUOTA`, `CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` and `CREATE ROW POLICY` now require the corresponding `DROP` privilege in addition to `CREATE`, because they overwrite an existing entity. Previously `CREATE USER` alone was enough to reset the password of any other user, including a privileged one. [#117960](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117960) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118747](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118747): A simple `Query` in the PostgreSQL wire protocol now destroys the unnamed prepared statement and the unnamed portal, as PostgreSQL does, so a later `Bind` or `Execute` on them is rejected instead of silently reusing stale extended-query state. A `Flush` or unimplemented message sent outside an extended-query cycle also no longer leaves the connection unable to answer further queries; that half only affects unreleased code from [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108469). [#118210](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118210) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118692](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118692): Fixed object storage listing silently skipping objects when S3 returns an empty page together with a continuation token. This could make a `plain_rewritable` disk appear empty and hide table parts, and could make data lake tables read a stale snapshot. [#118615](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118615) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#118777](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118777): Make 05054_embedded_rocksdb_explicit_dir_file_grant stress-restart safe. [#118220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118220) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* For `04238_alter_rename_column_merge_race`, apply 1 code line change suggested by AI. For `04408_lazy_materialization_part_offset_prewhere`, disable parallel replicas. [#118783](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118783) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.34.136-lts (4c1242ee175) FIXME as compared to v26.3.33.24-lts (211b7286fd9)

#### Backward Incompatible Change
* Backported in [#121228](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121228): Outbound TLS connections now verify that the server certificate names the host that was connected to. This affects `clickhouse-client --secure`, `remoteSecure()`, `Distributed` over the secure native protocol, secure Keeper connections, and HTTPS clients such as `s3()`, `url()`, HTTP dictionaries and JWT token endpoints. Connecting to an endpoint whose certificate does not name it, for example an IP address with no matching SAN, an S3-compatible gateway fronted by a different name, or an internal CA with missing SANs, now fails with `Unacceptable certificate`. Set `openSSL.client.extendedVerification` to `false` to restore the previous behaviour, or pass `--tls-sni-override` to name the host the certificate was issued for. Loopback addresses stay exempt unless `verificationMode` is `strict`, and the default for `openSSL.server.extendedVerification` is unchanged. [#116724](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116724) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122174](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122174): A MySQL dictionary source created with a `CREATE DICTIONARY` query can no longer enable `enable_local_infile`, at the source or at one of its `REPLICA` entries; loading such a dictionary fails with `BAD_ARGUMENTS`, which with the default `dictionaries_lazy_load` is on first use rather than at `CREATE`. A `REPLICA` that does not set the key inherits the source's value, as the connection pool does. To keep the option, define the dictionary in a server configuration file; `enable_local_infile 0`, and a `SOURCE(MYSQL(NAME ...))` reference to a named collection where the key was never read, are unaffected. [#120972](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120972) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#121586](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121586): You can now disable reading through the `executable` table function and from `Executable`/`ExecutablePool` tables with the new `allow_executable_tables` setting, for a deployment that must not run arbitrary server-side scripts. It defaults to `true`, so existing behavior is unchanged. [#120713](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120713) ([Hanzi Jiang](https://github.com/HanziJiang)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#117529](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117529): Avoid eager JSON serialization of Iceberg manifest entries when iceberg_metadata_log_level is below the call site's threshold. [#110437](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110437) ([Andy Bradshaw](https://github.com/andybradshaw)).
* Backported in [#120624](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120624): Parsing an HTTP request that carries many query parameters or headers with the same name (for example thousands of repeated `role=` parameters) no longer takes quadratic time. [#114410](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114410) ([James](https://github.com/sanjams2)).

* Backported in [#120627](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120627): Treat `max_size = 0` and `max_elements = 0` in `IFileCachePriority::check` as "no limit", consistent with how `canFit` interprets these values. This silences spurious `Cache limits violated` logical errors on priorities created with zero limits (such as the per-query filesystem cache priority used when `enable_filesystem_query_cache_limit` is on). [#101428](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101428) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120571](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120571): More security validations for biglake catalog. [#105117](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105117) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119903](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119903): Write partition field summaries into the Iceberg manifest list. [#118796](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118796) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119966](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119966): Bump the internal libssh from 0.12.0 to 0.12.2. [#119262](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119262) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#122371](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122371): Iceberg partition pruning now uses the partition value of a `day`, `month`, `year` or `hour` transform for a filter that wraps the partition source column in a monotonic function, such as `WHERE toDate(ts) = '2024-01-20'`, including for partition values from before 1970. [#119302](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119302) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#122187](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122187): Fix LOGICAL_ERROR crash "Current component is empty" when querying `system.part_moves_between_shards` with `enforce_keeper_component_tracking` enabled. [#101462](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101462) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119002](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119002): Fixes silent data loss for TTL expressions that apply large intervals directly to `Date` / `DateTime` source columns by widening the arithmetic away from 16/32-bit overflow. [#101793](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101793) ([BoloniniD](https://github.com/BoloniniD)).

The soft memory limit was calculated once at startup and cached, so subsequent config reloads had no effect. After this fix, the limit is recalculated and applied immediately on every config reload, no Keeper restart required. [#104940](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104940) ([Kai Zhu](https://github.com/nauu)).

[#107064](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107064) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

* Backported in [#120194](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120194): Fixed SQL injection in the MySQL wire protocol: the `SHOW TABLE STATUS LIKE` argument and the `SET <mysql_setting>` value sent over the MySQL interface (port 9004) are now parsed and re-quoted instead of being concatenated verbatim into the rewritten query. [#108474](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108474) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118973](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118973): Fixed RabbitMQ table engine hanging indefinitely on `DROP TABLE` or server shutdown when the broker closes the AMQP connection due to missed heartbeats without sending a TCP RST. All blocking event loop calls now have a 30-second timeout so shutdown always completes. [#108497](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108497) ([Aly Ayman](https://github.com/alyelmorsy-dataengineer)).
* Backported in [#117537](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117537): The `ArrowFlight` table engine and the `arrowFlight` table function now honor the `<remote_url_allow_hosts>` allow-list. Previously the connection host and port were not validated, so a query could reach hosts not present in the allow-list. [#108507](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108507) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121883](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121883): Fixed dropping whole parts with TTL (`ttl_only_drop_parts = 1`) still reading all data from large, fully-e

xpired parts. [#108626](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108626) ([Michael Jarrett](https://github.com/EmeraldShift)).
* Backported in [#118921](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118921): Rejects non-monotonic `Array` offsets on every read path that decodes them as absolute values, instead of only in the `Native` format. A corrupt `set` skip index granule previously passed unchecked and was then read out of bounds. [#109212](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109212) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119203](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119203): Fix a crash when reading Iceberg tables with equality delete files. If a column is nullable in the equality delete file but non-nullable in the table schema (or vice versa), the values read from the delete file were inserted into a column of a different type through an unchecked cast (a column type confusion), corrupting the column and crashing the server. [#109551](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109551) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#122117](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122117): Fix an accounting leak in memory tracking: when an allocation was rejected by a parent memory tracker (for example, the server-wide memory limit), the thread, query, and user level trackers kept the rejected amount. The error accumulated over time, inflating `MemoryTracking` and per-query/per-user memory usage, and could lead to spurious `MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` errors. [#110784](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110784) ([Seva Potapov](https://github.com/seva-potapov)).
* Backported in [#118991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118991): Fix `PREWHERE` (and row-level policies) on an Iceberg column that was renamed by schema evolution silently returning `0` rows for old data files. * Backported in [#119620](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119620): Fixed potential data loss when an `INSERT` into `ReplicatedMergeTree` was cancelled or timed out while ClickHouse was recovering an uncertain Keeper commit. [#111196](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111196) ([kakao-tars-case](https://github.com/kakao-tars-case)).
* Backported in [#122241](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122241): Fixes a server crash (double free) when finalizing an aggregate function with the `-State` combinator nested under a combinator that transfers several sub-states in one call (`-Resample`, `-ForEach`, `-Map`, `-Tuple`), for example `groupArrayStateResample`, if an exception such as a memory limit is thrown part-way through the transfer. [#111287](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111287) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118997](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118997): Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE` leaving the replaced object behind under an internal name when the caller lacks the drop privilege on it. [#111466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111466) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#114443](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114443): Restrict local object access only for user files path. Continuation of https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99405. [#111483](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111483) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#118761](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118761): Fixed a SQL injection in the PostgreSQL metadata queries. The `schema` of the `PostgreSQL` database engine, the requested column names and the publication name were formatted into SQL literals without escaping, so a value containing a quote could execute arbitrary SQL on the connected PostgreSQL server as the role ClickHouse connects with. Reaching it through `schema` needed only `CREATE DATABASE` plus use of a named collection whose `schema` is overridable. [#111516](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111516) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#120601](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120601): Fix a race between a `ReplicatedMergeTree` mutation and the removal of old temporary directories that could publish a mutated part with some of its files missing, making reads of that part and all its later mutations fail. [#111992](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111992) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119875](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119875): Fixed a crash when reading a subcolumn of a `Variant`, `Dynamic` or `JSON` column whose own type is `Nullable` or `LowCardinality(Nullable)` from a `MergeTree` table, for example ``SELECT value.`Tuple(a Nullable(UInt32), b String)`.a`` over a `Dynamic` column.
